outOfScope: The Orders KPI adapters read CONVERSION_RATE, ABANDONED_CARTS and the others from ps_configuration, but AdminStats getKpi writes them to ps_configuration_kpi: the cache never hits, so every load shows placeholders and makes four fetches.

AdminStats getKpi should return plain text ready to display, formatted like the server-rendered path: Average Order Value comes back without its tax scope, and the conversion rate as the literal '∞%' entity instead of '∞'.
An employee who can read Orders but not Stats gets a dash on all four cards: hide the row, or skip the refresh, when AdminStats is not readable.
